name: Phennova
bio: A place for the things I build on my own time: games, tools and experiments.

projects.title: Daily Builds
projects.summary: A new creative game or tool every day, built with an AI agent.
projects.description: A public repo where one finished, dependency-free browser game or tool lands every day. Each build has its own README, design notes and screenshot, and runs straight from a link on a phone.

timeline.text: Repo and nightly pipeline set up. First build: a carrier-landing game.

projects.title: Rulebound
projects.summary: A Minecraft challenge-run mod where you play by a set of rules.
projects.description: A NeoForge mod for Minecraft. Pick a rule pack (dietary, religious, the Ten Commandments and more), break a rule and the run is over. Supports shared-world races between players.

timeline.text: Faith and diet packs added; client testing still to do.
